# A test taking no component, in a package whose body renders nothing, builds
# nothing to render: there is no root, so every component was an entry point
# of its own. bubbletea and fyne emitted a component's view and focus helpers
# against a Model holding none of its state (focus), and html refused a
# component built at run time a reactive `if` hands a prop (built).

sngl test --platform=none focus.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html focus.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go focus.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go focus.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go focus.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin focus.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none built.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html built.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go built.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go built.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go built.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin built.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- focus.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func double(n int) => n * 2

component panel ui.node {
    var hits = 0
    ui.button #hit(text="hit", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
    ui.text(value="{hits}")
}

func testPanel(t test.Test, c panel) {
    c.hit.click()
    t.assert(c.hits == 1)
}

func testNoComponent(t test.Test) {
    t.assert(double(2) == 4)
}
-- built.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func double(n int) => n * 2

component row(label string) ui.node {
    var taps = 0
    ui.button(text=label, @click { taps = taps + 1 })
}

component page ui.node {
    var names = ["a", "b"]
    var open = false
    for var n = names {
        if open {
            row(label=n)
        }
    }
    ui.button #show(text="show", @click { open = true })
}

func testNoComponent(t test.Test) {
    t.assert(double(2) == 4)
}
